title: No Double Slabs (NDS)
description:
The mod itself is pretty self explanatory. Once enabled, it no longer allows you to place slabs on top of another slab. 

The goal of this mod is to make spawn proofing for farms extremely easy. Great QOL Mod.

https://discord.gg/NkWHjReMUP - My Lounge, jo
